purpose: Make runtime stability analysis falsifiable, repeatable, multiscale and fail-closed.

evidence_ladder.meaning: A directly measured value or structural delta exists.
The observation recurs across at least three independent captures and an explicit falsifier has been attempted.
Repeated observation co-varies with an outcome and at least two independent source types contribute evidence; causality remains forbidden.
Association also has temporal precedence, explicit falsifier testing and alternative-explanation review.
Causal candidate additionally survives controlled intervention or reversal/reproduction.

baseline.zero_mad_rule: candidate outside observed min/max is deviation, not causality
baseline.independence_rule: input paths and snapshot bytes must be unique; exact duplicate evidence is rejected

observation_quality.rule: low-quality or incomparable observations must become TOKEN_VAZIO rather than negative evidence

multiscale_rule: Evidence from one scale cannot promote another scale without an explicit bridge.
falsifiability_invariants: same app identity != same process generation
compact fingerprint drift != structural identity drift

evidence_independence.rule: independent evidence requires distinct independence_group values, not merely distinct labels/source_type strings

hyperMemory_chain.eviction_rule: if the predecessor cannot be observed after ring eviction, emit TOKEN_VAZIO_EVICTED_PREDECESSOR instead of GENESIS
hyperMemory_chain.chain_claim: payload SHA-256 links are local causal-order evidence, not causal proof

storage.publication: temp + fsync + exclusive hard-link + directory fsync
